source: P01.294; ADR-0130 Addendum (20) item 1; Architect answer 2026-11-12T22:03:33Z
removed: The target `P/01/production` of the registry has the engine word `production`. Its inventory (N1.4) is the 17 [case groups](../../../01-store/spec/production-acceptance.md#case-groups) `RUN-*` and the 13 probes of N6.3, which are the rows of [the probe debt](../../../01-store/spec/production-acceptance.md#probe-debt) by name. An entry is executed once: `RUN-L03` is the first initial state of `prod-stop`, and `RUN-F01`, `RUN-F02`, `RUN-F04` are the stages of `prod-fault-stage`; their results are shown under both names. The rows of [`forms/production.tsv`](../../../01-store/forms/production.tsv) list this inventory with the inputs and terms of each entry; the table names the entries and adds no outcome.

source: P01.294; ADR-0130 Addendum (20) item 1; Architect answer 2026-11-12T22:03:33Z
removed: The term of a probe is the last column of its row; the term of a group is its row in [the first approved budgets](../../../01-store/spec/production-acceptance.md#first-approved-budgets). The monotonic resolution and the scheduling uncertainty of the judge are calibrated separately and recorded; they do not increase a budget. An entry judged by its outcome alone is bounded by the budget of the target (N3.3). A timeout of the judge, a forced kill, a counter of the producer, an EIO text or a library return is no GREEN.
